name: Cap Captcha
description: The self-hosted CAPTCHA for the modern web.
composeYaml:
services:
  cap:
    image: 'tiago2/cap:3.0.4'
    environment:
      - ADMIN_KEY=${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - 'REDIS_URL=redis://valkey:6379'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - bun
        - '-e'
        - "fetch('http://localhost:3000').then(r => { if (!r.ok) process.exit(1) }).catch(() => process.exit(1))"
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 5s
    depends_on:
      valkey:
        condition: service_healthy
  valkey:
    image: 'valkey/valkey:9-alpine'
    volumes:
      - 'valkey-data:/data'
    command: 'valkey-server --save 60 1 --loglevel warning --maxmemory-policy noeviction'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - valkey-cli
        - ping
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
